canDo: Can state a clear position with two developed reasons, expressing necessity or wishes with il faut que / vouloir que and the like.
review: Review cause and effect and organising words; learn the high-frequency subjonctif triggers.
input: Listening and reading on school/study issues.
output: Write a 150-word opinion; give a spoken opinion in 3 minutes.
checkpoint: The opinion has two developed reasons; at least 3 subjonctif structures of necessity/wish done correctly.
challenge: Today’s challenge: on “Should secondary-school pupils wear a uniform every day?”, write a 6-sentence opinion: take a clear position, give 2 reasons and use the subjunctive at least 2 times (Il faut que… / Je voudrais que…); you can first find a short text about school on TV5MONDE or Le Point du FLE for ideas.

questions.why: « ça correspond à combien ? » — showing that what really works is having something at stake tied to the result.
« les conflits n'ont pas diminué, ils se sont déplacés », and by the afternoon they have already taken shape.
« le vide en collège ne reste jamais vide » — the sports hall, table-tennis tables, the library without booking.
